data.name: Poker Fate - Anime Girls Texas Hold'em
data.detailed_description:
Poker Fate – Choose your poker partner and enter a duel against fate!

Play for free! Dive into thrilling Texas Hold'em with charming characters, dazzling effects, and endless excitement.

"In this battle of wits, your hand decides fate—yet it's you who will rewrite the ending."

When rivalry and cooperation collide at the table, when the balance of strategy and luck shifts—

your destined poker partner awaits, ready to fight at your side!

Join Poker Fate now and experience the ultimate heart-pounding Texas Hold'em showdown!

Whether you're a poker rookie or a seasoned pro, you'll find your perfect game here!

【Game Features】

♦️ Classic Texas Hold'em – Free to Play ♦️

• Authentic Texas Hold'em rules: two hole cards plus five community cards—build the strongest hand and claim victory!

• Multiple modes and tournaments: completely free to play, no pay-to-win! Enjoy whichever mode you like as you climb the rankings.

• Abundant rewards: log in daily, complete missions, and play anytime, anywhere to earn exciting prizes!

♦️ Adorable Live2D Characters – Double the Bonding Fun ♦️

• Cute, fully animated characters stand by your side in every match!

• Express yourself with exclusive emotes and voice lines at the table.

• Raise Affinity through poker and make a vow to your characters to unlock new outfits, voices, and emotes for deeper interaction!

♦️ Beginner-Friendly with Full Support ♦️

• A complete tutorial makes learning easy for anyone.

• Hand Replay lets you revisit your game history, analyze plays, and sharpen your strategy.

• Share your hands with friends or watch top players in action to grow your skills!

♦️ Popular Tournaments & Thrilling All-in Effects ♦️

• Fast-paced action! Dive into SNG modes with free daily challenges!

• Feel the adrenaline rush in classic MTTs (Multi-Table Tournaments) where every hand counts!

• Experience our unique "All-in animations"—featuring spectacular Victory and Battle Damage animations that capture the life-or-death tension of going all-in!

• Customize your characters, tables, backgrounds, and special effects to create your own unique flair!

♦️ Famous Japanese Voice Cast ♦️

• Characters brought to life by top voice actors!

• Uesaka Sumire, Hara Yumi, Suguta Hina, Nishio Yuka, Kobayashi Aika, Okubo Rumi, Fujita Akane, Hasegawa Ikumi...

• Stay tuned for continuous updates featuring mysterious new characters and stunning special animations. Look forward to your romantic encounters at the poker table!

【Recommended For You】

♥️ Poker Lovers ♥️

• Fans of Texas Hold'em, Omaha, and other classic poker variants.

• Players who crave strategic mind games against opponents worldwide.

♥️ Anime Fans & Gacha Collectors ♥️

• Those who love collecting characters, outfits, and special effects, or customizing their tables.

• Casual players seeking stress-free games and relaxed matches with friends.

♥️ Strategy Game Fans ♥️

• Players who enjoy analyzing hands and tactical play.

• Bluffing masters who live for mind games.

• Risk-takers who thrive on precision and calculated strategy.

♥️ Competitive Multiplayer Players ♥️

• Pros looking for real-time global competition.

• Friends teaming up to climb the rankings.

• Players eager to meet fellow poker enthusiasts.

♥️ Fans of Free Casual Games ♥️

• Newcomers who want a high-quality poker experience at no cost.

• Gamers who prefer casual play, anytime and anywhere.

【Notice】

• All in-game currency, items, and characters are virtual assets meant strictly for in-game use.

• This game does not involve real-money gambling or offer real-world financial prizes.

• Poker Fate welcomes beginners and pros alike—everyone interested in poker is invited to join!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1以上
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Dual CPU E2180 2.00GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 430 / ATI Radeon HD 2600XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 – 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 430 / ATI Radeon HD 2600XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
During poker gameplay, if a player loses all their chips in a match, character illustrations and Live2D animations featuring damaged clothing will be displayed. This revealing content includes partial nudity and is therefore classified as adult content.
Additionally, some in-game character illustrations may contain suggestive poses or themes, constituting adult-oriented content.
